items.title: Dunkley leads Trent Rockets past SunRisers Leeds
items.summary: Sophia Dunkley's 56 off 33 balls fired the Trent Rockets past SunRisers Leeds in an impressive victory by five runs in The Hundred at Trent Bridge.
